paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption_used: The character distribution in RoleplayPref is organized into three primary categories — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 subcategories in the outer ring. Virtual Characters occupy approximately 60% of the distribution and are subdivided into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters forming the largest virtual subcategory. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата представя разпределението на различни категории герои в набор от данни наречен RoleplayPref. Има общо 3 основни категории и 13 подкатегории. Основните категории включват Virtual Characters (Виртуални герои), които заемат приблизително 60% от диаграмата и са оцветени в нюанси на синьо, Custom Characters (Персонализирани герои), които са с розов цвят и заемат малка част, и Real Characters (Реални герои), които са зелени и заемат около една трета от диаграмата. Виртуалните герои са разделени на 5 подкатегории: Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters и Game Characters. Реалните герои включват 7 подкатегории: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors и Influencers. Диаграмата не включва етикети с проценти вътре в секторите, но има ясни етикети за всяка категория и подкатегория. Персонализираните герои нямат допълнителни подкатегории. Подкатегориите на виртуалните и реалните герои са подредени в кръг около основните категории, като виртуалните герои са разделени равномерно около своята основна категория.
model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates the distribution of characters across different categories. The chart is divided into 13 slices, organized into three main categories: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters. Virtual Characters is the largest category, occupying approximately 60% of the chart, and is further subdivided into five subcategories: Comic Characters (light blue, around 18%), Game Characters (light blue, around 13%), Novel Characters (light blue, around 10%), Teleplay Characters (light blue, around 9%), and Movie Characters (light blue, around 9%). Custom Characters is represented by a pink slice, making up around 20%, but has no visible subcategories. Real Characters, colored green, accounts for approximately 20% and is divided into seven subcategories: Scientists (dark green, around 3%), Artists (green, around 3%), Athletes (green, around 3%), Writers (light green, around 3%), Musicians (light green, around 4%), Actors (light green, around 3%), and Influencers (pale green, around 2%). The chart does not include a legend, but labels are placed inside or adjacent to each slice. No slices are visually emphasized. The subcategories are arranged in a ring around the main categories, with the Virtual Characters subcategories grouped together and the Real Characters subcategories listed in a rough clockwise order.
